		limit = { sg_law_available_law_party_reactionary_only = yes NOT = { enacting_any_law = yes } }
		start_enactment = law_type:law_party_reactionary_only
	}
	# Rerank even when the guard failed: the row is stale and must
	# disappear or change instead of looking like a dead click.
	sg_rank_laws = yes
}

}
